meta.title: Anthony Football Coaching — Seminole County, FL
meta.description: Professional football coaching in Oviedo, FL. Training sessions for youth and high school athletes.

about.name: Coach Anthony
about.bio: Former NFL player, 1st team College All-American, 2000 NCAA Interception Leader with over 12 years of experience in coaching and player development. I can help your child reach all their athletic goals with tailored training sessions.

hero.headline: Seminole County's Premier Football Coach
hero.subline: Personalized football training that turns potential into performance.
